resources.string: This pack applies the square glyphs. The Core Builds Icon Pack applies the 16:9 banners. Both cover the same apps, so switching between them changes what an icon looks like, never which apps get one.

To apply glyphs everywhere, choose Core Builds Glyphs in the icon pack list of your launcher. On Projectivy that is Settings, then Icon pack. The Art style switch inside the icon pack does the same thing, and installs this pack if it is missing.
